description: Search Indeed from your terminal — with a local job history no scraper keeps, so you can ask what's new since last time and grep everything offline.

novel_features.name: New jobs since last run
novel_features.description: Re-run a saved search and show only the postings that appeared since you last looked.

novel_features.name: Offline full-text search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across every job you've ever synced, with no network call.

novel_features.name: Saved searches
novel_features.description: Persist a named query with all its filters so you can re-run it by name.

novel_features.name: Salary floor filter
novel_features.description: Drop results whose parsed salary falls below a threshold.

novel_features.name: Multi-location fan-out
novel_features.description: Run one keyword across several locations in a single command and dedup by job key.

novel_features.name: Track a job
novel_features.description: Add a job to a local shortlist you can list and annotate later.
